title: torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler.unscale_ raises on fp16 params after optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

`GradScaler.unscale_` raises `ValueError: Attempting to unscale FP16 gradients.` when the model parameters are fp16 and the optimizer was zeroed with `set_to_none=True`.

```python
import torch
model = torch.nn.Linear(8, 8).cuda().half()
opt = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1)
scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()
opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
with torch.autocast("cuda"):
    loss = model(torch.randn(4, 8, device="cuda").half()).sum()
scaler.scale(loss).backward()
scaler.unscale_(opt)   # ValueError: Attempting to unscale FP16 gradients.
```
